observations: Photo 0 shows a black headlamp with a bright white light beam, placed on a beige shaggy carpet. The headlamp has a rectangular battery pack with a blue LED indicator and a pink label with text. The strap has 'LED LIGHT' printed on it.

Photo 1 shows the same headlamp from a side angle, revealing the lens and a small yellow LED chip inside. The battery pack has a red label with 'LED' and '12V' visible. The strap has 'LED LIGHT' printed on it.

Photo 2 shows the headlamp from a top-down angle, with the battery pack and strap clearly visible. The strap has 'LED LIGHT' printed on it. The battery pack has a red label with 'LED' and '12V' visible. The headlamp is connected to a black cable.
All photos show the same headlamp from different angles, placed on a textured carpet. The lighting in the photos is bright, with the headlamp emitting a strong beam in photo 0 and photo 1.
No visible damage or wear is apparent on the headlamp in any photo. The strap appears intact and functional.

claims.claim: This is a 5000mAh battery powered rechargeable super bright light worn on the head for work or...
claims.evidence: The battery capacity is not visible in any photo. The 'rechargeable' claim cannot be verified without seeing the charging port or charging cable. The 'super bright' claim is subjective and not verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The battery may not be 5000mAh or may be non-rechargeable.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the battery pack showing the capacity label or a photo of the charging port and cable.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-rechargeable or lower-capacity headlamp

risks.risk: The headlamp may not be functional or may have a damaged lens or internal components.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the headlamp turning on and emitting light from all angles, including the beam and side lights.

risks.risk: The headlamp may have a damaged or missing strap or adjustment mechanism.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the strap and adjustment mechanism, showing all parts and their condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a damaged strap

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the battery pack showing the capacity label or charging port.
A video clip showing the headlamp turning on and emitting light from all angles.
A close-up photo of the strap and adjustment mechanism.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
